old_string:
if text == new_text:
                # The callbacks didn't change the text, so we yield the new "a"
                # token, then whatever else was there, then the end "a" token
                yield a_token
                yield from token_buffer[1:]

            else:
                # If the callbacks changed the text, then we're going to drop
                # all the tokens between the start and end "a" tags and replace
                # it with the new text
                yield a_token
                yield {"type": "Characters", "data": str(new_text)}
                yield token_buffer[-1]
new_string:
if text == new_text:
                # The callbacks didn't change the text, so we yield the new "a"
                # token, then whatever else was there, then the end "a" token
                yield a_token
                # Process any entities in the text tokens
                for token in token_buffer[1:-1]:
                    if token["type"] == "Characters":
                        yield from self.extract_entities(token)
                    else:
                        yield token
                yield token_buffer[-1]

            else:
                # If the callbacks changed the text, then we're going to drop
                # all the tokens between the start and end "a" tags and replace
                # it with the new text
                yield a_token
                # Process any entities in the new text
                yield from self.extract_entities({"type": "Characters", "data": str(new_text)})
                yield token_buffer[-1]
